cases.case_label: Retroposed TMF1 transcript (processed pseudogene) in CYBB intron 1
cases.mechanism_detail: A 5.8-kb, partly exonized TMF1 transcript retroposed (LINE-1-mediated) antisense into CYBB intron 1 causes inclusion of an extra 117-bp exon between exons 1 and 2 containing a premature stop. Inherited from the mother, who was a somatic mosaic (early fetal event) in whom the insertion was only in methylated DNA.
cases.quote: This insertion induced aberrant CYBB mRNA splicing, with inclusion of an extra 117-bp exon between exons 1 and 2 of CYBB.
